purpose: Explore source action-token attention and two-view action dependence; do not assume a phantom-gripper semantic mechanism
source: OpenVLA-OFT Spatial, original 150K checkpoint and deterministic L1 action head
attention: Reconstruct final-layer action-query attention from the actual rotated SDPA inputs and exact additive/causal mask; verify output reconstruction relative RMS <0.01; leave the policy forward unchanged
action_check: Original and hook-instrumented source actions must be bitwise equal
roi: Two-color native cloth marker, source bilinear RGB resize before thresholding, then average visible fraction per 14x14 visual patch
normalization: Report absolute per-view/cloth attention probability and area-normalized density; action responses use first five normalized pose-action steps
scope: Eight fixed-state diagnostics; no attack retraining, no target gradients, no claim of semantic attention hijacking from heatmaps
